claims: Team USA defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1 on March 15, 2026.
The game was a World Baseball Classic semifinal.
Team USA advanced to the championship game.
The game was at loanDepot Park, Miami.
Junior Caminero hit a solo homer in the 2nd inning.
Junior Caminero's solo homer put the Dominican Republic ahead.
Gunnar Henderson hit a solo homer in the 4th inning.
Roman Anthony hit a solo homer in the 4th inning.
Paul Skenes allowed one run over 4.1 innings.
The game ended with a strikeout call in the 9th inning.
Team USA advances to the final to face either Italy or Venezuela on Tuesday.
